name: generic-sample
description: The small XcodeGen + CocoaPods workspace in examples/generic-sample: a check of the benchmark itself. Plain worktrees are set up the usual way (xcodegen, pod install) and built with xcodebuild into the global DerivedData; xcfs uses the sample's own config.

plain.build: xcodebuild build -workspace GenApp.xcworkspace -scheme GenApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet

edits.name: add a declaration to the pod
edits.append: public enum XcfsBench{n} { public static let v = {n} }
